lexicalContexts.method: 70候选在新原创真实训练中覆盖；来源形态不一致和旧例句未入原文的情形不强行计为旧正文精确覆盖。

newKnowledge: be一般疑问句及完整短答
review: I am/you are、姓名、班级、数字和大小写
limits: 第一课不变；第二课所有原材料保留，只追加五份原创材料。
第三课起仅重新安排既有语法材料，首次安排与计划巩固明确区分；没有新增365套独立新知识。
材料内容经Codex逐题核对，未称真人教师审题、独立盲解或真实考生难度标定。
语音与自由表达评阅仍须真实服务；音频缺失时正式构建失败，不以文字替代听力。
360分钟为学习和休息共用预算；参考分配不要求坐满，未完成原稿可续做。

yearExpansion.rights: Project-original sources by default; linked third-party resources and unlicensed GitHub PDFs/audio are not bundled.
yearExpansion.limits: Two new readings and two new listenings weekly, rotated with explicit revision; not seven unique new texts each week. Source generation, hashes and service success do not prove learner Band 7.

integrationRequirements: Assign a real versioned week/day and budget before course-player integration.
Use stable source.exposureGroup across both modalities and versions; new question/source versions never reset prior exposure.
Respect blocked listening readiness and canonical audio usage; no TTS replacement or audio redistribution without clearance.
publicSupplements.limits: Staged question set only. AI source-text blind agreement does not establish actual audio alignment, human-examiner validity, difficulty calibration, learning outcomes or IELTS Band.
publicSupplements.listeningUse: 29 provider-paired original Conversation files, not independently auditioned; ordinary practice only
publicSupplements.protectedHistoryPolicy: Started/frozen days, drafts and attributable records keep their bound original; new assignments reroute only after profile readiness.
publicSupplements.contextExecution: Word/grammar context links and review windows are author plans, not executed recall tasks or mastery.
